up: Retrieve all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier 'CHEMBL3880421'. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), and, if available, its canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures). Link the document to records via the compound_records table (using doc_id), then to molecules via molregno. Include only molecules that are associated with this document; do not apply any additional filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880421';
